title: But narcissists are an evil that cannot be saved
You either rise with them or get swept beneath
What is time but a house abandoned?
Frankly, I had no words to place here.
The threads of life are delicate, and our attention matters
“Fear is the little-death that brings total obliteration.”
The world will see what hid in skin
To encounter her is to face contradiction incarnate
Because the mind naturally demands why
A song that sanctifies our tears
